title: IV / IV-rank snapshot (iv-snapshot/1)
description: ATM implied volatility and its rolling percentile rank for one underlying, published by algo_scalper_api (IV authority: broker chain IV + Black-Scholes solver + iv_rank_tracker over a rolling window, default 20 trading days / 500 samples, plus daily iv_snapshots). Consumers (agent sizing rules, dashboards) apply their own thresholds - share data, not decisions.

expiry.description: Expiry the ATM IV was read from; null when blended across expiries.

atm_iv.description: At-the-money implied volatility as a fraction (0.15 = 15%).

atm_iv_ce.description: ATM call IV, when tracked separately.

atm_iv_pe.description: ATM put IV, when tracked separately.

iv_rank_pct.description: Percentile rank of current ATM IV within the rolling window (0 = lowest ever in window, 100 = highest). Null when the window has too few samples.

iv_percentile_pct.description: Alternative percentile measure, when both are computed.

window_days.description: Rolling window length in trading days (default 20).
